title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, India
description:
**Job Description**

In 2025, we started Handshake AI and built the fastest-growing AI data business in history. We work directly with frontier AI lab researchers to create evaluations, publish benchmarks, and push the boundary of data. We’ve grown from $0 to ~$1B run rate and pay ~$60M to over 30K individuals every month.
  
  
Why join Handshake now
  
  

* Shape how every career evolves in the AI economy, at global scale, with impact your friends, family and peers can see and feel
* Partner hand-in-hand with world-class AI labs, Fortune 500 partners and the world’s top educational institutions
* Work together with engineers, scientists, operators, and more from Palantir, Meta, Scale AI, and former YC founders
* Build a massive, fast-growing business with billions in revenue

**About Handshake AI**
Human data is the core infrastructure to AI advancement. Frontier AI labs currently improve model capabilities with various data-intensive post-training techniques. We believe that data spend for AI training will increase by 3-5x in the next few years and continue for much longer as models take on new domains. Handshake AI supports all of the frontier AI labs, working on their most complex data at the largest scale.
  
  
**About The Role**
We're hiring a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer to work directly with frontier AI labs to solve their most complex engineering challenges.
  
  
As a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll own the end-to-end lifecycle of customer deployments—from understanding technical requirements to architecting, building, and scaling production systems that improve customer workflows and model performance. You'll operate across the stack, partnering closely with Engineering, Research, Product, and Operations teams in both India and the US to deliver solutions for our most strategic customers.
  
  
This is a unique opportunity to combine deep software engineering with customer partnership, helping shape how Handshake AI delivers solutions to the world's leading AI labs.
  
  
Location: Bengaluru, India. This is an in-office role.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* Partner directly with frontier AI labs to understand complex technical challenges and translate them into scalable engineering solutions
* Partner closely with Engineering, Research, Product, and Operations teams in the US to execute against a shared roadmap
* Design, build, and deploy production-grade applications that solve high-impact customer problems
* Own technical architecture for customer deployments with a focus on reliability, scalability, security, and maintainability
* Rapidly prototype, test, and iterate on solutions based on customer feedback
* Build reusable tools, frameworks, and deployment patterns that improve delivery across customer engagements
* Mentor engineers through technical leadership, code reviews, and engineering best practices
* Help establish a strong engineering culture as we continue building our India engineering organization

What We're Looking For
  
  

* 6+ years of professional software engineering experience
* Experience leading technically complex customer-facing, solutions engineering, or forward deployed engineering projects
* Strong proficiency with TypeScript, React, and modern backend architectures
* Deep understanding of relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL), system design, distributed systems, and cloud infrastructure
* Experience building and operating production systems on AWS or GCP
* Strong technical judgment and the ability to solve complex engineering problems in fast-moving, ambiguous environments
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
* Experience collaborating effectively with globally distributed engineering teams, including teams based in the US

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience building AI-powered products, LLM infrastructure, or machine learning platforms
* Experience working directly with enterprise customers or strategic technical partners
* Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines
* Experience supporting applied AI or ML research teams
* Experience working in a fast-growing startup or high-growth engineering organization

What Success Looks Like
  
  

* Customer deployments launch successfully and deliver measurable value
* Technical solutions become reusable across multiple customer engagements
* Deployments are reliable, scalable, and easy to maintain
* Customer feedback directly informs platform improvements and future product capabilities
* You become a trusted technical partner across customers and engineering teams in both India and the US

You’ll Thrive Here If You
  
  

* Are motivated by solving operational problems that have direct, measurable impact.
* Want to be part of a company shaping the future of AI through human data.
* Can navigate ambiguity, act with urgency, and keep multiple workstreams moving in parallel.

Perks
  
  

* Generous Equity Grant vested over 4 years
* Housing Bonus: 1.3 Lakhs spread throughout the first year

* Medical Insurance Coverage
* Food credit for every in person day.

title: Deployment Strategist
description:
**Job Description**
About the Team
  
  
The FDE (Forward Deployed Engineering) team is a new, strategic initiative sponsored from the CEO and Founders down. Our mission is to win C-suite-sponsored, high-value AI opportunities by selling and delivering outcomes, not just a platform.
  
  
You will be part of the founding team, embedded with our most strategic customers from the very first sales call, all the way through to a production-ready solution. You will be the "product manager" for the customer's problem, responsible for the "why" and "what," while our FDEs (Engineers) will be your partners responsible for the "how."
  
  
Role Description
  
  
As a Deployment Strategist (DS), you are the critical bridge between a customer's multi-million-dollar business problem and Databricks' technical solution. You are a product manager for the field, owning the technical and product direction of the engagement from initial discovery through production launch and adoption.
  
  
You will build C-suite trust, perform deep discovery to map the customer's political and technical landscape, and scope the value. You will define the Minimum Viable Product for a pilot, write the PRD that guides the engineering team, and manage the project to a successful landing. You will also lead technical discovery, shape solution architecture with FDEs, and ensure that each proposed solution can move from prototype to production.
  
  
This role requires a rare combination of executive presence, deep product thinking, technical depth, and a hands-on delivery mindset.
  
  
The impact you will have
  
  

* C-Suite Scoping & Value Definition: Partner with Sales to perform deep discovery, map the customer's organization, quantify the business value of $10M+ problems, and define the pilot, including its MVP, success criteria, and timeline.
* End-to-End Product Ownership: Author the PRD, prioritize the engineering backlog, manage scope, and act as the primary hands-on QA tester. Translate business requirements into clear data, integration, security, and operational requirements that engineers can build against.
* Technical Solution Leadership & Delivery: Drive the FDE build team through an agile delivery process, manage stakeholders from the C-suite to individual engineers, and unblock technical or organizational issues. Lead technical discovery and design reviews. Understand the customer's data flows, integrations, platform constraints, and operational environment; pressure-test architecture choices; and identify technical risks early.
* Solution Launch & Landing: Own the "Day 0" launch, manage the war room, and drive the solution from launch to full adoption by capturing user feedback, iterating, and proving the defined business value. Own production readiness across data quality, testing, security, performance, and operations. Work with the team to diagnose issues and drive them to resolution.
* Strategic Handoff & Growth: Scope the ongoing maintenance plan, create customer documentation/training, and leverage your trusted advisor status to identify the next high-value FDE engagement. Codify reusable solution patterns and bring field insights back to Product and Engineering.

What we look for
  
  

* Executive Presence & Communication: You are a trusted advisor with strong executive presence and excellent communication skills. You are confident and humble, can build rapport quickly, and can help senior stakeholders make difficult decisions.
* Product Judgment & Delivery: You can define what to build and why, write strong product requirements, prioritize engineering work, manage scope, and lead complex agile software projects from an ambiguous problem to a measurable outcome.
* Technical Fluency & Architecture Judgment: You understand modern data and AI architectures, including cloud platforms, data pipelines, data models, distributed systems, APIs, security and governance, machine learning, and generative AI application patterns. You can lead architecture discussions, evaluate trade-offs, and pressure-test technical decisions.
* Hands-on Technical Ability: You are proficient in at least one language such as Python, Java, or SQL. You can explore data, work in notebooks, read and review code and pipelines, build or adapt prototypes, and contribute meaningfully to troubleshooting.
* Relevant Experience: Typically 7+ years of experience delivering complex, customer-facing data, analytics, AI, or software engagements, or equivalent experience as a founder or technical builder. You have helped deliver data, machine learning, or generative AI systems into production and understand the integration, operational, and adoption challenges that appear in real environments. Experience in a high-growth technology company, forward-deployed organization, or leading consultancy is valuable. You enjoy working onsite with customers (often 25-50%, sometimes higher) to drive delivery.

**About Databricks**
Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.
  
  
**Benefits**

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
  
  
At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

title: Senior Staff Engineer
description:
Sprinto is an
**Autonomous Trust Platform**
that centralizes trust requirements across
**security frameworks, vendors, and customers.**
Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.
  
  
Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve
**raised**
**$31.8M**
in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over
**4,000 organizations across 75 countries**
, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With
**300+ native integrations**
and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports
**200+ global security standards natively**
, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.
  
  
**Founded in 2020**
by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.
  
  
**Life as a Sprinter -**
Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.
  
  
We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.
  
  
Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together; they're built by pulling in the same direction.
  
  
We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.
  
  
And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.
  
  
**The mission -**
Autonomy is the easy half. Making it defensible is the hard half.
  
  
What the platform produces is not a suggestion that a customer can take or leave. It's used as fact by auditors and enterprise buyers whose decisions depend on us being right. Wrong in one direction, a customer loses a certification because of us. Wrong in the other, we bury them in noise until they stop reading anything we send.
  
  
Your mission is to make a defensible half, making agent judgment something a third party will accept.
  
  
**Where you'll leave your mark?**
**Agents whose output nobody re-checks.**
You'll see how we prove an agent is trustworthy: evaluation harnesses that gate releases rather than run quarterly, golden sets built with real compliance experts, regression suites assembled from production traces, and drift detection that fires before a customer notices. Not a set of scripts — a platform every other team builds on. You'll know it works when a compliance lead stops reviewing a category of output, and nothing breaks.
  
  
**A system that can prove what it said, and admit when it didn't know.**
Compliance is a claim about the past, which means state as of a date has to be held separately from when we learned it, and every artefact has to carry unbroken provenance from the source system to the audit package. The other half of the problem is honesty under failure. At several hundred connectors, partial failures are normal, and a connector returning nothing because Okta is down must never look like a control genuinely failing. Passing, failing and unknown are three different states, and that distinction has to survive all the way to the interface.
  
  
Beyond those two, there are surfaces you'll work across without owning alone: tenant isolation and enterprise identity as we move upmarket, the inference economics that decide whether continuous monitoring is viable at scale, and how we model 200 frameworks so the next one is cheap. And since every engineer here will be building with agents within a year, we'll expect the practice to be better across the org because you joined.
  
  
**The kind of builder we're looking for -**

* Someone who has built something that changed the shape of the work. Not a prototype — a system where an LLM took autonomous, multi-step action against real data and real users, and displaced something people used to do by hand. We'll want to hear what it replaced, what it cost, what its failure rate was, and how you measured it.
* An engineer who treats the model as an untrusted subsystem. Constrained outputs, independent verification, thresholds that escalate rather than guess, a clear line between what the model decides and what it only proposes. We're more interested in how your system detected and contained a bad output than in how it tried to prevent one.
* Depth in at least two of these, with room to pick up the rest here: production LLM and agent systems; temporal and provenance data modeling; high-fan-out integration reliability; multi-tenant and enterprise identity; inference cost engineering; domain modeling for messy regulatory rules.
* 10+ years building software, at least two of them at Staff scope — setting technical direction that engineers outside your reporting line followed.
* Range. Some quarters this role is an architect setting direction, some quarters it's the person taking on the problem nobody has cracked, some quarters it's carrying a team through a hard delivery. The people who do well here read what the company needs and adapt.
* Willingness to challenge how we build, and to hold the line when it counts. We're hiring partly for disagreement — on our architecture, our agent design, our standards. That includes telling go-to-market what we can't yet defend, and offering a path rather than a refusal.
* Influence without authority. Nobody on this team reports to you. Your leverage is clarity, credibility and the quality of your reasoning across Engineering, Product, Security and CX — and since we're remote-first, most of that happens in writing.

**How we care for our Sprinters?**

* Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach
* Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance
* We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills
* We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to
* Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary
* Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you

**Inclusion & Diversity -**

The Full Stack Engineering Department builds the Agoda web and app products. We have several teams in front-end focusing on different aspects of our products including accommodations, flights, payments, marketing, post-booking services, and more. Agoda’s marketplace is the world. We build localized and optimized user experiences at scale on every major internet platform. These include our mobile websites, native apps, and desktop sites. We hire people from around the world who have a passion for using technology to create and implement the best user experiences. Our teams work on the full stack and build end-to-end systems including user interfaces, APIs, backend systems, and database systems. Our products are always evolving and under experimentation. We accomplish this by having an amazing degree of automation, CI/CD systems, and use a modularized approach. As we are data driven and measure our results, we continually innovate and improve our work. We are looking for the next great talent who strives to learn and grow and has a standard of excellence, strong sense of ownership, and great technical skills.
  
  
**The Opportunity:**
Staff Engineer is the key role in our technology organization working together with individual contributors and senior leadership. Our Lead engineers are heavily involved in the hiring and mentoring process and are the go-to people who design and implement new systems and components. We are looking for people who are passionate to take on more responsibility and driving major architectural changes in Agoda. It's expected from you in this role as Staff engineer to push Agoda forward technically by adopting new technologies and setting higher standards.

* Lead full-stack architecture and system design for features used by millions of customers across web and cross-platform environments.
* Own complex end-to-end systems: Take responsibility for building, integrating, and maintaining both frontend and backend components, including the critical Backend for Frontend (BFF) layer.
* Mentor and guide high-performing teams: Provide technical leadership, drive engineering excellence, and support the growth of your peers.
* Drive technical decisions: Influence architecture and best practices across multiple squads, ensuring scalable, reliable, and high-quality solutions.
* Collaborate with Product and Design: Work closely with cross-functional partners to deliver cohesive, user-centered features and experiments that directly impact business outcomes.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 8+ years of experience in software engineering, with a strong record of technical leadership and end-to-end ownership.
* Expertise in Java, Kotlin, .NET, and JavaScript/TypeScript, plus hands-on experience with frameworks such as Node.js and React (or similar TypeScript frameworks).
* Proven experience leading end-to-end architecture on high-traffic, high-availability platforms, ideally with exposure to cross-platform or migration projects (e.g., native to WebView).

 and Gemini to scaffold services, write and refactor across the stack, generate tests, and reason
 



 about tricky data and finance logic — targeting a 3x\-5x efficiency gain. You'll practise Cross\-LLM
 



 Validation: one model writes, another reviews for correctness and edge cases. Your value is
 



 measured by working, correct, shipped product — features that reconcile, screens that delight,
 



 deploys that hold — not lines or tickets.

* Backend \& Data: Design and build Node / Express services (customer, admin,



 user\-center, ingestion, aggregation) with clean boundaries. Own the schema, migrations,
 



 and queries (Sequelize \+ raw SQL) across a 20\+ table financial data model, from bronze
 



 ingest to gold aggregates.
 


* Correctness to the Rupee: Implement and defend the finance logic — payouts,



 reconciliation, ad\-spend, taxes — where "almost right" is wrong; verify against source
 



 data every time.

 generation (Puppeteer / exceljs), and third\-party integrations (Razorpay billing, WhatsApp
 



 / Meta, Keycloak).

 local\-first Dexie) and the admin console with clean, reusable, strongly\-typed components;
 



 package and ship via Capacitor with real\-device polish, responsive layout, and offline
 



 behaviour.
 


* Dashboards \& Reports: Turn dense financial data into fast, legible dashboards, filters,



 and downloadable reports customers trust.
 


* Data Pipeline: Extend the Gmail\-OAuth pipeline that fetches, parses, and normalises



 Zomato / Swiggy statements (drift\-tolerant, config\-driven parsing). Own the aggregators
 



 that roll raw orders into reconciled daily / weekly / monthly metrics — accurate,
 



 idempotent, re\-runnable.
 


* Delivery \& Quality: Ship features from schema to deploy using a git\-based deploy flow;



 write meaningful tests (Vitest / Jest / node:test) and verify real output on real data; chase
 



 bugs to root cause across the full stack.
 


* Ownership \& Leadership: Make and defend architectural decisions; set code, review, and



 documentation standards; mentor other engineers; and translate product and finance
 



 requirements into correct, shippable software with leadership.

 and frontend.

 in the database, not just an ORM).

 component architecture.

 reconciliation matter.
 


* A track record of taking features from design through deploy — and making architectural



 decisions solo.
 



 Should\-Have
 


* Mobile / cross\-platform delivery: Framework7, Capacitor, React Native, Flutter, or



 equivalent.
 


* Data pipelines: ingestion / ETL, background jobs (BullMQ / Redis), batch / aggregation



 logic.
 


* AWS deployment (EC2 / RDS / S3\), git\-based deploy flows, and basic ops.
* Integrations: OAuth (Gmail / Google), payments (Razorpay / Stripe), messaging



 (WhatsApp / Meta), and auth systems (Keycloak).

 you build.
